verdict.rationale: Asana documents a RESTful, resource-oriented JSON API with a per-endpoint API reference and in-context explorer, token auth and a quick start, and official JavaScript and Python libraries. It also offers webhooks, a developer sandbox, a formal deprecation process with Asana-Change/Enable headers, and an official OpenAPI spec on GitHub; the docs are agent-readable via llms.txt and markdown pages. The probe 404s on well-known OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, because the spec is published in the Asana/openapi repo. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that driving the product through the API works in practice.
